get_parameters_models: get experiment parameters for Fashion-MNIST model training with MLP architecture and learning rate 0.05
get_parameters_conformal_training: get conformal training parameters with threshold_logp method and normal size loss for Fashion-MNIST

get_parameters_confusion_2_4_6: get conformal parameters with triple loss matrix sweep for confusion between classes 2, 4, and 6
get_parameters_confusion_6: get conformal parameters with row loss matrix sweep targeting confusion for class 6
